properties.completeness: Deliberately incomplete. Two features is the number of sites with a citable position, not the number of sites that exist.
caveats: THIS LAYER HAS TWO FEATURES BECAUSE ONLY TWO SITES HAVE A CITABLE POSITION. It is not a survey of satellite infrastructure on the island, and a sparse layer must not be read as an absence of infrastructure.

STARLINK IS NOT PLOTTED. Starlink is licensed on the island via a BlueWave partnership, with CURA confirming a licence in 2021, but dish coordinates appear only on third-party trackers with no operator confirmation.
Arqiva's 'Chalfont' teleport is in BUCKINGHAMSHIRE, NOT the Isle of Man. A widely repeated Data Center Dynamics claim to the contrary is wrong. It is excluded deliberately.
No OneWeb, Galileo or BeiDou ground infrastructure has been located either way. Absence here is not evidence of absence on the ground.

The IOMS GNSS reference station is positioned at the EGNS aerodrome reference point because the station's own surveyed position is not published. This is accurate to the airfield, NOT to the station. Do not use it for survey-grade work.
Spectrum licensing is administered by CURA. There is no public earth-station licence register for IoM-located sites, so this layer cannot be made exhaustive without operator or regulator cooperation.
Dish positions change. Ground stations are re-pointed, added and decommissioned, and this layer was not resurveyed after its source date.

properties.name: Spaceman teleport (aql Space Services)
properties.placementRationale: Selected for low horizon clutter and separately allocated spectrum, with dark fibre into the aql UK network and access to BlueWave masts including the adjacent 40 m CARNANE1 tower.
properties.lineage: Site lineage: SES announced an IoM teleport in September 2016, withdrew in summer 2021; BlueWave acquired the site around 2020. Now aql Space Services.

properties.name: IOMS GNSS reference station
properties.purpose: Survey-grade geodetic GNSS reference. This is a positioning reference, NOT a communications downlink, and it is not part of any satellite ground-station network.
properties.positionNote: Positioned at the EGNS aerodrome reference point. The station's own surveyed position within the airfield is not published.
properties.coordSource: EGNS aerodrome reference point from OurAirports, used as a proxy for the station position. Accurate to the airfield, not to the antenna.
